nodes.name: Extract and Normalize Entities
nodes.notes: Deterministic extraction only. Limits output to 20 total and 10 per entity type; performs no network requests.

parameters.query:
WITH input_entities AS (
  SELECT
    item.ordinality::INTEGER AS input_order,
    item.value ->> 'entity_type' AS entity_type,
    item.value ->> 'normalized_value' AS normalized_value
  FROM jsonb_array_elements($1::jsonb) WITH ORDINALITY AS item(value, ordinality)
)
SELECT
  input_entities.input_order,
  input_entities.entity_type,
  input_entities.normalized_value,
  scam_entities.status,
  scam_entities.report_count,
  scam_entities.confidence_score,
  scam_entities.source
FROM input_entities
LEFT JOIN scam_entities
  ON scam_entities.is_active = TRUE
 AND scam_entities.entity_type = input_entities.entity_type
 AND scam_entities.normalized_value = input_entities.normalized_value
ORDER BY input_entities.input_order
LIMIT 20;

nodes.name: PostgreSQL Lookup
nodes.notes: After import, select a PostgreSQL credential. The fixed query binds the extracted entity array as $1; submitted values are never concatenated into SQL.

nodes.name: Normalize Intelligence Result
nodes.notes: Returns one safe internal result. Phone and bank-account values are redacted; database errors and connection details are discarded.

parameters.content:
## Phase 5A/5B — isolated intelligence lookup
This sub-workflow is not connected to Text Analysis Main V2. It extracts phone, bank-account, and domain entities deterministically, performs one parameterized PostgreSQL lookup, and returns a normalized internal result. No public webhook or scoring behavior is present.
